theme: An open calendar — a good day to move the decisions that have been waiting.
greeting: Nothing is on the calendar today, Dan, so the whole day is yours. The girls are with you and Mike, and a couple of travel calls have waited long enough that today is the day to make them.

needsAttention.title: Reserve the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The p1 board item to book a full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas is about five weeks overdue. Holiday inventory there is the hardest in the market and sells out — a refundable hold now removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Decide-by was Sept 30 and the Oct 15 book-by has now passed. Travel for six over three weeks is the thinnest inventory of the year, so the domestic-vs-international call needs to land.

needsAttention.title: Reply to the CIFIC recruiter
needsAttention.detail: Amin Noorani at Noorani + Partners wrote on Oct 15 about the VP, Government Relations role at CIFIC and offered to discuss further — a four-day-old thread still waiting on your reply.

flagged.title: Board-search InMail on LinkedIn
flagged.detail: Terence Quek, a partner in a CEO & board practice, nudged for a response on LinkedIn — board-search outreach worth a quick look.

flagged.title: Toronto stay confirmed Nov 2-5
flagged.detail: Airbnb booked the photo-studio loft for your Nov 2-5 Toronto trip.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail and promos — Li-Lac, Audible, Chairish, a couple of Airbnb upsells.
inbox.clear: Nothing security- or finance-urgent sitting in the inbox.

recipe.title: Apple galette
recipe.why: Autumn apples are at their peak, and a free-form galette lets their sweetness and the first cool air do the work.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order - bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder
Drive the Pathfinder down to St Pete

acts.line: No meetings on the calendar — the morning is entirely unclaimed.
Still nothing scheduled; the open stretch is the day's one real feature.
A quiet evening at home with the girls.
